summary: Implemented OCR-2: an accessible opt-in OcrPanel with all statuses, title autofill/apply/dismiss, persisted OCR metadata, confirmed clear, capture and card-detail wiring, 18 focused component/integration tests, and a real-tesseract Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented OCR-2: an accessible opt-in OcrPanel with all statuses, title autofill/apply/dismiss, persisted OCR metadata, confirmed clear, capture and card-detail wiring, 18 focused component/integration tests, and a real-tesseract Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.
decisions: Empty titles are filled from the first meaningful OCR line and announced; non-empty titles only change through Apply.
Capture OCR metadata is written in the same atomic card transaction as the photo; card detail writes it through updateCard.
Clear OCR uses nullable CardPatch OCR fields so removal is validated and persisted rather than client-only.
The production worker uses absolute same-origin asset URLs and the explicit SIMD LSTM loader because bundled assets do not include the relaxed-SIMD core.
Clear confirmation restores focus to the OCR panel heading when the Clear trigger unmounts with the result.
interfaces: OcrPanel({ image, title, initialResult?, onTitleChange?, onApplyTitle?, onPersist?, onClear?, onResultChange?, ocrOptions?, disabled?, headingLevel?, id? })
NoteSourceForm gained image?: OcrImage | null and NoteSourceValues.ocr?: OcrResult
CardPatch OCR fields accept null to clear

payload.taskDescription: Create OcrPanel with idle, loading, reading, done, failed, and timed-out states; a progress indicator; Cancel; Run again; Clear OCR; text; confidence; and engine version. Wire it into NoteSourceForm for a pending image and CardDetailPage for a saved card. When the title is empty, apply the first meaningful OCR line and announce it. When the title is non-empty, show Suggested title with Apply and Dismiss and never change the field automatically. Persist text and metadata on success; clearing removes it after confirmation. Add component tests and a Playwright journey that reads a clear fixture, accepts a title, searches the text, reloads, and verifies persistence. Do not add search or backup code.
